description:
Combat Chatter Voice Addon

A voice pack addon for Combat Chatter that plays voice audio during combat when matching chatter lines appear.

Demo Video

https://youtu.be/PX17qM8cXRY

Download

Download from Google Drive

Requirements

* Starsector 0.98a
* Combat Chatter
* LunaLib optional, but recommended for in-game settings

Features

* Adds voice playback for Combat Chatter lines without modifying Combat Chatter itself.
* Assigns voice audio to Combat Chatter characters and their individual chatter lines.
* Uses ship-position audio with distance correction.
* LunaLib Mod Options can be used to adjust voice volume, playback interval, and related settings.

Included Voices

This addon includes 13 voice profiles:

* Male / Female Captain: Cautious, Steady, Aggressive, Reckless, Timid
* Male / Female Default(Non-officer) Captain voices
* AI Core / Automated Ship voice

The addon also includes documentation for replacing voice files, creating custom voice packs, adding support for other Combat Chatter-compatible characters, and understanding voice mapping/fallback behavior.

Supported Voice Maps

* Core Combat Chatter characters
* Ship and Weapon Pack
* SS-armaa
* Tahlan Shipworks

Additional mod character support can be added through the included documentation.

Performance Note

This addon contains approximately 20,000 voice audio files, so Starsector may take longer to load during startup. After loading, normal gameplay performance should not be significantly affected.

Install

* Extract the mod into your Starsector mods folder.
* Enable Combat Chatter and this addon.

Credits

* Combat Chatter by Histidine
* Voice generation used ElevenLabs, Chatterbox TTS, and Qwen3-TTS

Feedback Welcome

This is my first Starsector mod release. Bug reports, voice issues, compatibility reports, and suggestions are very welcome.
